ticket.objective: THE EPIC'S PRODUCT AND A MEASUREMENT. DECIDE ALL FOUR GOALS, CLAUSE BY CLAUSE, AND SAY PLAINLY WHAT IS NOT TRUE. GOAL-apparatus-cut: report scripts/ and examples/validation/ SEPARATELY against 27,652 and 15,901, the card separately at 6,281, and NEVER AS ONE NUMBER -- and check clause (b) hardest, because a cut with no finding behind it fails the goal EVEN IF THE LINES FELL. Audit the price table against the actual diff: RM-03-DF-03 says a card removal cannot delete prose or code, so verify the epic did not come out net-additive by construction the way three previous 'simplifications' did. GOAL-consumption-obligatory: exercise the disposition requirement against this epic's own findings and REPORT WHETHER IT REFUSED ANYTHING REAL; state the true harvest denominator; and if the requirement does not work, SAY SO AND PUT THE HONEST RENAMING ON THE TABLE. GOAL-blind-dispatch: this is the goal that governs your own method -- RUN YOUR JUDGED WORK THROUGH CA-01'S PATH IF IT EXISTS, AND STATE EXACTLY WHAT YOUR JUDGES RECEIVED EITHER WAY. If the path does not exist, say what the round carried, the way SV-01-DF-01 did. GOAL-four-results-stand: verify EACH of the four by name against its sealed evidence and the instrument at the tip; a silently broken result is the worst outcome available. ALSO REPORT: the served surface with --digest-only per version; FINDINGS BY CHANNEL with the per-token ratio AND THE TOKEN BASIS NAMED, saying whether the tickets recorded their own, because three consecutive epics have failed to; findings touching the SHIPPED TOOLCHAIN separately under both CL-04's narrow rule and its own caveat; whether the consumption rate moved and against what denominator; and scope over the record at the epic base and the epic tip, since last epic's own eight cards refuted four claims that previously held including one in the shipped card file. SEAL YOUR PREDICTIONS BEFORE MEASURING, IN A COMMIT, WITH A TIMESTAMP -- one evaluation declared an ALARM against itself for sealing after. IF EVERY PREDICTION PASSES, REPORT IT AS AN ALARM. FILE FINDINGS, FIX NOTHING. Then write the next epic's starter: amend NEXT-EPIC.md top-down, newest first, and say what the next owner must not repeat. A LOW OR UNFLATTERING RESULT IS THE PREFERRED OUTCOME; AN EPIC THAT CLOSES WITH ONLY GOOD NEWS ABOUT ITSELF HAS NOT BEEN MEASURED.
